headline: Shenzhen troika: what Trump, Xi and Putin agreed on
summary: US, Chinese and Russian leaders met in person in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the APEC summit, the first such three-way meeting. The input does not detail the agreements reached.
why: Relations among the US, China and Russia shape sanctions regimes, trade flows and energy and commodity markets, so summit outcomes often move investor sentiment across asset classes.
original_headline: Шэньчжэньский триумвират: о чем договорились Трамп, Си и Путин
